description: Scrape every seller offer for one or more Amazon ASINs from the All-Offers-Display ("Other Sellers on Amazon") panel.

asins.description: Amazon ASINs to fetch offers for, e.g. `B0DCH8VDXF`.
asins.title: ASINs

conditions.description: Only emit offers of this condition. Amazon's offer panel surfaces 4 distinct condition buckets -- New, Used, Collectible, and Renewed (Amazon Renewed program) -- each matched exactly ("Used only" never silently includes Collectible/Renewed offers).
conditions.title: Condition filter

deliveryCountry.description: 2-letter destination country. Offer sets are destination-dependent; also selects the default marketplace domain for bare ASINs (ignored when `productUrls` supplies its own domain).
deliveryCountry.title: Delivery country

fulfillmentTypes.description: Only emit offers with this fulfillment type. Derived from Amazon's own explicit "Ships from"/"Sold by" labels: FBA (Fulfilled by Amazon -- ships from Amazon, sold by a third-party seller), AMAZON (sold and shipped by Amazon itself), FBM (Fulfilled by Merchant -- the seller ships it themselves). Leave empty for no filter. Offers where the fulfillment type couldn't be confidently derived are excluded whenever a filter is set (but still included when this filter is empty).
fulfillmentTypes.title: Fulfillment type filter

maxOffersPerProduct.description: Hard cap on the number of offer records emitted per ASIN (the buy-box/pinned offer counts as one).
maxOffersPerProduct.title: Max offers per ASIN

postalCode.description: Destination postal code to refine delivery estimates. Optional.
postalCode.title: Postal / ZIP code

productUrls.description: Full Amazon product URLs (any `/dp/{ASIN}` link). The marketplace domain and ASIN are both extracted from each URL.
productUrls.title: Product URLs

proxyConfiguration.description: Uses the free AUTO (datacenter) proxy group by default. Some marketplaces (e.g. amazon.co.uk, amazon.de) drop datacenter connections outright, so the actor fast-fails a network-level timeout on a target and automatically retries it once under a RESIDENTIAL session -- a bounded fallback, never the default.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

title: Amazon Offers Scraper Input
